title: Second Vaccination Drive
content:
In view of covid-19 the second vaccination drive is held on 07th July 2021 i.e., Wednesday for all the Students & Staff Members of the ATME College of Engineering; henceforth the online classes will be suspended and the same needs to be compensated in the next week appropriately.

As the vaccination drive is conducted within the campus, it’s compulsory for all the students to be vaccinated. Therefore, instructed to all HOD’s and faculties to bring this notice to all the students who are not yet vaccinated.
